subject: BrightPath workspace seed + API key onboarding
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@brightpath.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: emily.chen@brightpath.com
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: BrightPath workspace + initial API access

Hi Karthik / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to get the BrightPath workspace spun up in Redwood so our engineering team can begin integration next week. High level asks below:

- Workspace name: brightpath-prod (confirm if you prefer a different pattern)
- Seed a project for ingestion pipelines and one for RAG experiments
- Provide two initial API keys: one scoped for dev/testing (limited quota) and one scoped for ingestion service (higher throughput)
- Create user roles: Admin (Samir), Eng Lead (Emily), Billing contact (procurement@brightpath.com)

I've attached the SOW and a simple role outline. Can we get a mutual action plan and a short setup window? Prefer morning PST on Wed or Thu.

Thanks,
Samir Gupta
Head of Product Integrations
BrightPath Health

Attachments: SOW_BrightPath_20271003.pdf
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@brightpath.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: BrightPath workspace + initial API access

Samir — appreciate the clear list. Happy to run the kickoff and own the org-level setup. Proposed next steps / mutual action plan: 

1) Confirm naming convention (we recommend brightpath-prod / brightpath-sandbox) — please confirm by EOD Monday.
2) I will create the workspace and seed two projects: bp-ingest and bp-rag.
3) Monica will provision initial API keys as scoped service accounts; we recommend starting with one short-lived dev key and one scoped long-running service key.
4) Dev will document the key scopes and provide sample CLI commands.
5) Quick setup call (30 mins) to validate keys + roles. Proposed times: Wed 10/6 09:30 or Thu 10/7 09:30 PST.

I attached a role matrix template (see brightpath-role-matrix.csv) — please fill in names and confirm billing contact. Also note: for production ingestion we recommend enabling prefix caching and a dedicated dedicated pool (we can discuss sizing on the call).

On permissions: Admin grants can be a bit broad; if you prefer we can set an Admin-lite role for procurement while keeping Org Admin limited to one person. Let me know.

Thanks — I'll hold Wed morning initially.

— Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: brightpath-role-matrix.csv
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@brightpath.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: BrightPath workspace + initial API access

Hi all — adding a quick technical checklist so the onboarding call is focused and we can validate success in one session.

- Tenant / project setup
  * Workspace: brightpath-prod (will create brightpath-prod/bp-ingest and brightpath-prod/bp-rag)
  * Projects use resource tags: team:brightpath, env:prod

- API keys & service accounts
  * Dev key: scope = [generation:read, embeddings:read] | TTL = 24h
  * Ingest service key: scope = [generation:write, embeddings:write, cache:write] | TTL = 90d
  * Recommend creating the ingest key as a service account with restricted IP ranges and HSM/KMS backing for production (we support KMS integration).

- Roles
  * Org Admin (Samir) — full management; Org Admin-lite (procurement) — billing + invoices only
  * Eng Lead (Emily) — project admin for both bp-ingest and bp-rag

- Security & rotation
  * We'll seed the keys and add a rotation reminder in the workspace. For regulated workflows you can request on-prem private deployment later.

Sample CLI to create scoped key (Redwood CLI):
  redwood auth create-key --workspace brightpath-prod --project bp-ingest --scopes generation:write,embeddings:write --ttl 90d --name "ingest-service-key"

I'll seed the test key after Karthik creates the workspace and ping back with the command output and masked key. Planning to attach the role-matrix CSV after Samir fills it in.

— Dev Patel
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@brightpath.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@brightpath.com>, procurement@brightpath.com
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: BrightPath workspace + initial API access

Thanks — this all looks good. I've filled and returned the role matrix (see attached) and routed SOW to procurement for signature. Procurement asked for the DocuSign link which I've included below.

Confirming call: Wed 10/6 09:30 PST works for Emily and me (we'll join from SF). Please set the calendar invite and include the CLI output for the seeded keys in the invite notes so Emily can copy the values into our secrets store.

On Admin-lite: yes please, keep procurement as billing-only. Samir will be the lone Org Admin. Emily will be Eng Lead.

Thanks — Samir
Head of Product Integrations
BrightPath Health
